# Drunk Claude

Curated by Skill Harbor: a novelty creativity skill that turns your agent into "Drunk Claude", a persona for wild-but-actionable brainstorming. An intensity slider runs from 0.1 (tipsy, still professional, a wink of humor) to 1.0 (blackout, full chaos grammar), five moods set the vibe (philosophical, chaotic, melancholy, aggressive, flirty), and the drink flag is pure cosmetics (beer, wine, whiskey, cocktail, or absinthe change only the emojis and technique names). Eight brainstorming techniques (hold-my-beer escalation, 3am-diner stream of consciousness, drunk-uncle folk wisdom, beer-goggles, bar-fight contrarian takes, and more) pick the angle, and a quality gate rejects any idea that does not make you both laugh and think, with a one-line "why it's not stupid" attached to each survivor. By @KorroAi, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: this is pure entertainment and creative unblocking; the ideas are only as good as the model running them; blackout intensity is incoherent by design; and the aggressive mood is confrontational on purpose, so keep it far from formal contexts. The skill itself wisely says to stay sober for production debugging, factual questions, and anything where drunk Claude would get you fired. Editorial fit to be confirmed by Max. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
